# Acme Widget repo, full context

> Expanded agent context for the Acme Widget repository.

## Project

Widget manifest formatting tools. TypeScript ESM on Node 22.

## Layout

- `src/` holds the implementation.
- `test/` holds hermetic vitest suites.
- `docs/` holds operator documentation.

## Verify

Run `npm run typecheck && npm run lint` plus the touched vitest suites.
